Logical gap: H_min quantifies over an unspecified R and unspecified N/costs while evidence_used=[] and materials empty—so H_min is not currently empirically decidable; it is only a schema for future decidability. Operational gap: failure rule Π_N ≤ 0 does not reject non-predictive survivors (flat, tiny risk, multi-test winners). Revised freezeable experiment (ACTION-or-NO_ACTION): NO_ACTION if pre-registration incomplete; else ACTION = run exactly one continuous N-period shadow freeze path for the single registered R under locked costs/calendar/exposure stake; record π_k, Π_k, positions, info-cutoff proofs; apply failure criteria below; output retain-or-eliminate only.

Stake policy (explicit): (i) scientific/production stake = elimination of this R from the production candidate set if hard-fail; (ii) no real-money, no external effects, no account settlement; (iii) single R per experiment slot (K=1) unless a separate pre-registered family budget exists—default K=1; (iv) exposure stake: pre-register E_min such that (1/N)sum|w_k| ≥ E_min or count(|w_k|≥w_min)/N ≥ f_min, else fail; (v) cost stake: pre-register cost/slippage function C; path must use C only.

Failure criteria (hard): F1 Π_N ≤ 0 → eliminate R; F2 exposure stake not met → eliminate R (or ineligible); F3 any post-freeze revision of signals/parameters, calendar, or costs → audit fail, path invalid, R not credited; F4 missing info-cutoff proof for any period → path invalid; F5 if pre-registration bundle incomplete at t1 → NO_ACTION (no pass/fail on R). Non-failure: Π_N > 0 ∧ exposure met ∧ audit clean ⇒ retain unfalsified candidate only.
